title: Improved Space-Time Tradeoffs for Permutation Problems via Extremal Combinatorics
summary: We provide improved space-time tradeoffs for permutation problems over additively idempotent semi-rings. In particular, there is an algorithm for the Traveling Salesperson Problem that solves $N$-vertex instances using space $S$ and time $T$ where $S\cdot T \leq 3.1861^{N}$. This improves a previous work by Koivisto and Parviainen [SODA'10] where $S\cdot T \leq 3.9271^N$, and overcomes a barrier they identified, as their bound was shown to be optimal within their framework.
